mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.10% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.10%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 5.0% signals tight labor market conditions, strengthening consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0, or correlation with positive returns is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 100.5 while housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 indicates manufacturing strength offset by housing weakness, triggering negative equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5 and HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL decline below 260.0 during monetary tightening cycles signals cooling inflation from rate hikes, typically preceding recession and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 260.0 during tightening, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 units indicate strong consumer demand for housing, boosting construction and retail sectors, which typically generates positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 persons signal robust job growth, strengthening consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000, or correlation with positive returns is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consumer credit (RSAFS) above 550,000 million dollars combined with FEDFUNDS below 0.10% indicates strong consumer demand alongside accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when RSAFS > 550000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.10, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 during manufacturing slowdowns signals sector contraction, typically leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 during slowdowns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
